name: USMLE Step 2 CK Prep: Vignetta
subtitle: Vignettes, ECG, pathways, mock
shortDescription: Original Step 2 CK vignettes, decision pathways, ECG strips and lab drills with a cited guideline behind every answer. Free, works offline.
longDescription:
USMLE Step 2 CK Prep: Vignetta teaches the way the exam asks: a short patient vignette, five options and a decision that matters, such as the diagnosis, the best next step, the right treatment or what to tell the patient. It follows the official USMLE content outline: every one of the 303 points of the USMLE Content Outline (2026) has its own lesson and at least 8 original questions. The Coverage screen in the app shows the exact count, point by point.

### Practice
- 2,424 original clinical vignettes with a reason for every option, the reasoning steps and the trap
- Timed blocks of 20 questions in 30 minutes, plus mini-mock runs
- A diagnostic that finds your weak systems, spaced review and a mistake notebook

### Learn
- 303 short lessons that follow the outline, each citing authoritative open sources that open inside the app
- ECG rhythm strips, lab and blood gas drills, and a screening-test lab with live sensitivity, specificity and predictive values
- Decision pathways and guided case builds that you work through step by step
- Search the whole outline from one box

### It Adapts to You
The app tracks your mastery of every outline point on your device, links each missed question to its lesson, suggests the next best point with a reason, and lets you study in outline order or by real-world case.

### Comfortable to Read
Light, high-contrast design, text size from 50 to 300 percent, and wide layouts for tablets. Works offline. No account. A notice on first launch explains the optional usage sharing, which you can switch on or off at any time, and you can send feedback and suggestions from the app.

A study aid for exam preparation, not medical advice. Practice scores are estimates from your own practice and do not predict any exam result. Questions are original; there are no real or released exam items. USMLE is a joint program of the FSMB and NBME. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by USMLE, NBME, FSMB or ECFMG.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
